description: Report only the invoices that have line items, ranked by how many line items they have.

d.request: List the 10 invoices with the most line items in descending order, showing invoice number, average derived_total_cost to derived_product_cost ratio across line items, and line item count, including only invoices with at least one line item.
d.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost / ili.derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1 ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10

b.request: For each invoice with at least one line item, report the invoice number, the average ratio of derived_total_cost to derived_product_cost across its line items, and the count of line items, returning the top 10 invoices ranked by line item count in descending order.
b.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost / ili.derived_product_cost) as avg_ratio, COUNT(*) as line_item_count FROM Invoices i INNER JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10;
b.raw: For each invoice with at least one line item, report the invoice number, the average ratio of derived_total_cost to derived_product_cost across its line items, and the count of line items, returning the top 10 invoices ranked by line item count in descending order.

a.request: For each invoice that has at least one line item, show the invoice number, the average ratio of `derived_total_cost` to `derived_product_cost` across its line items, and its number of line items. List the 10 invoices with the most line items, from most to fewest.
a.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost / ili.derived_product_cost) as avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) as num_line_items FROM Invoices i JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY num_line_items DESC LIMIT 10

c.request: For each invoice, show the invoice number, the average ratio of `derived_total_cost` to `derived_product_cost` across its line items, and how many line items it has. Give the 10 invoices with the most line items, from most to fewest. Report only the invoices that have line items, ranked by how many line items they have.
c.sql: SELECT ili.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost / ili.derived_product_cost) AS average_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili GROUP BY ili.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10;
